sector-paris.name: Paris Outskirts
sector-paris.brief: The capital evacuation is underway. Secure the perimeter while civilians escape.

sector-lyon.name: Lyon Industrial Zone
sector-lyon.brief: Protect the arms factories from demonic saboteurs.

sector-strasbourg.name: Strasbourg Crossing
sector-strasbourg.brief: The Rhine bridge is our only supply line. Hold it at all costs.

sector-munich.name: Munich Defensive Line
sector-munich.brief: German forces are holding. Reinforce their position before the next wave.

sector-zurich.name: Alpine Fortress
sector-zurich.brief: Swiss bunkers provide excellent defensive positions. Clear the tunnels.

sector-vienna.name: Vienna Siege
sector-vienna.brief: The ancient city is under siege. Break through and liberate the defenders.

sector-brussels.name: Brussels Command
sector-brussels.brief: NATO headquarters is compromised. Extract classified intel before it falls.

sector-amsterdam.name: Amsterdam Harbor
sector-amsterdam.brief: Control of the port is essential for naval supply routes.

sector-copenhagen.name: Copenhagen Strait
sector-copenhagen.brief: The Baltic access point. Secure it to prevent naval flanking.

sector-prague.name: Prague Underground
sector-prague.brief: Ancient catacombs hide a dark ritual. Descend and disrupt it.

sector-berlin.name: Berlin Ruins
sector-berlin.brief: The fallen capital. Push through the devastation to reclaim the heart of Europe.

sector-warsaw.name: Warsaw Front
sector-warsaw.brief: The eastern defense line. Polish forces need immediate reinforcement.

sector-krakow.name: Krakow Citadel
sector-krakow.brief: An ancient fortress converted to a portal nexus. Assault and seal it.

sector-kyiv.name: Kyiv Siege
sector-kyiv.brief: The largest city still standing in the east. A critical strategic target.

sector-carpathian.name: Carpathian Pass
sector-carpathian.brief: Mountain passages crawling with enemy patrols. Clear the route.

sector-blacksea.name: Black Sea Coast
sector-blacksea.brief: Secure the southern flank. Naval demons are emerging from the depths.

sector-rift.name: The Eastern Rift
sector-rift.brief: The main invasion portal. Destroy it to turn the tide of war.
